opening.argument: The presentation directs viewers to create and fund a contract with ETH, then activate the bot so it can earn from Uniswap arbitrage. That funding flow is paired with a claimed return of “+7–9% daily per user” and the assurance that “the bot does not make any losses” and the user is “always on plus.” The tutorial further describes front-running pending transactions and profiting from another trader’s slippage. Although it later acknowledges that results are “not always profitable” and fluctuate week to week, that qualification does not remove the central promotion of ETH funding alongside unusually high-return and no-loss claims.

citations.quote: Copy your newly created Contract address as shown on video and charge it with any amount of ETH that you would like the bot to earn with by simply sending ETH to your newly created Contract address.
According to our latest data of bot performances (past 3 weeks) ROI is about +7–9% daily per user.
The bot does not make any losses, it only executes trades when there's proper arbitrage opportunity to make profit, so under all circumstances user is always on plus.
sometimes its not always profitable and profits fluctuate week to week
